rationale: The action events form a finite measurable partition; conditioning identifies each selected reward mean, and finite expectation linearity turns indicators into expected pull counts. This proves an equality of expected realized regret, pseudo-regret, and gap-weighted counts, with no selection or biconditional characterization.
